name: Offline Text to Speech
description: Offline text-to-speech for your whole computer. A Provider app: put it in your Providers folder, assign it to Text → speech in Settings → AI models, and every app that speaks uses it — no account, no key, nothing leaves your device.

say.label: Say something out loud on this device
say.detail: The voice is synthesised here, offline — nothing is sent anywhere, and nothing is saved.

voice.label: …in a particular voice
voice.detail: One of the app's voice names (nova, echo, onyx, fable, alloy, shimmer, whisper).
